name: vibecoding
description: Harness-first roadmap execution: generate dependency-aware roadmaps, build them with parallel agents, and independently validate every task by driving the running app

parallelAgentLimit.title: Parallel agent limit
parallelAgentLimit.description: Maximum number of phase-executor agents dispatched in parallel per phase. Set lower (e.g. 2) to reduce churn; higher (e.g. 6) when machine and token budget allow.

defaultEffort.title: Default agent effort
defaultEffort.description: Default reasoning effort for dispatched agents (low | medium | high | xhigh). xhigh applies to Opus agents (phase-executor, phase-reviewer).

worktreeParentDir.title: Worktree parent directory
worktreeParentDir.description: Directory under which parallel phase-executor worktrees are created. Relative paths are resolved against the project root.

autoCommitOnACPass.title: Auto-commit on AC pass
autoCommitOnACPass.description: When true, tasks are merged automatically once their AC gate passes and the validator returns PASS. When false, validated branches are left unmerged for review.

runPhaseReviewer.title: Run phase reviewer after integration check
runPhaseReviewer.description: When true, execute-roadmap and auto-execute-roadmap dispatch the phase-reviewer agent after each phase integration check; findings surface at the next milestone checkpoint.

validatorBasePort.title: Validator base port
validatorBasePort.description: First port handed to app instances booted by phase-executors and validators. Each concurrent instance gets its own pair (base + 2 x slot, and +1). Pick a range your projects' pinned dev ports don't use.
